description.value: Country Grocer is a family-owned Vancouver Island supermarket chain founded in 1984, now operating eleven stores across Greater Victoria, the Gulf Islands, and Vancouver Island. This Nanaimo location (Chase River) is one of two Country Grocer stores in the city, offering a full supermarket with deli, bakery, seafood, and fresh floral departments. The chain has a strong emphasis on local BC suppliers and farmers and deep community roots spanning over four decades.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website contact page lists 'Nanaimo (Chase) 250.753.7545 mdillabough@countrygrocer.com', exactly matching the OSM phone and email, confirming this is the Chase River Nanaimo location of the Country Grocer chain. The corporate website covers all eleven locations and provides no store-specific details on bike parking, washrooms, or cycling amenities, so those fields remain null. Basic groceries is confirmed true from the supermarket classification and the website's full grocery store content including deli, bakery, seafood, and produce departments.
concerns: The website is a corporate site for all eleven Country Grocer locations and does not list specific street addresses per store, so the OSM address (82 Twelfth Street) could not be cross-verified against the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible supermarket with confirmed phone match on the chain's own website. A well-stocked grocery store is directly useful to touring cyclists.
